static_traits.name: Liu Shan
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends she can confide in, but hesitates to express these feelings of inferiority and doubt; friendships affected by Self-doubt
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness;no history of similar psychological problems in the past;no prior history of psychotherapy or counseling
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly, with self-awareness and logic, can describe automatic thoughts concretely; emotion slightly tense, highly cooperative

basic_info.main_problem: After completing Master's degree, inferiority and Self-doubt emerged, worrying friends see her studies as a waste of time; especially triggered when talking about career paths and educational background, repeatedly worrying about others' opinions and affecting her sense of self-worth.
basic_info.core_demands: I want to stop this sense of inadequacy, start recognizing my own achievements, instead of constantly worrying about what others think of me.
growth_experiences: A few months after completing Master's degree, a friend said about her career choice, 'If you do not really use this degree, is the Learning worth it?' This comment dealt a significant blow to her self-worth; since then, social situations and career-topic conversations have repeatedly triggered inferiority and Anxiety.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough / I am a failure
My value depends on others' evaluations
If have not put the degree directly to use in the career, it amounts to waste and failure

special_situations.event: A friend commented on her career choice, 'If you do not use the degree, is it worth it?'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not used the degree directly in my career, it means my efforts are entirely Meaninglessness, I am just a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Seeks comfort and affirmation from friends; tries to persuade herself with positive self-talk
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They must think I have wasted all my time

special_situations.event: Talking about career plans and educational background at a friends' gathering
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not a clear career path, it proves all my efforts are failures: either everything fully matches the degree, or I am completely worthless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids or reduces communication about career topics, explaining/justifying their decisions as much as possible to lower the risk of being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I cannot put the degree to use in Work, then all efforts are wasted

special_situations.event: Reflecting alone on her career choice and 'whether she made a big mistake'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If have not put the degree to use in Work now, the future will only get worse and there is no way to undo it
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeated rumination and self-questioning, trying to briefly soothe with positive self-talk
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I made a huge mistake; this will ruin my career and life

special_situations.event: When discussing studies and career with friends and seeking affirmation, the other person has not yet given clear and consistent strong affirmation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only when others explicitly affirm me do I have worth; if the other person does not affirm me right away, it means I am really not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly seeking reassurance and recognition from different friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They have not said yes right away, which shows they also think I am a failure

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized, seen, and have self-worth affirmed
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being negated and humiliated, worrying about being seen as a failure and excluded from the group
defense_goal: Steadies self-esteem and relationship safety by seeking external recognition
Avoids direct conversations about careers and the usefulness of degrees to reduce the risk of being evaluated
Avoiding stronger negation from others through Self-deprecation and preemptive negation

object_relations.self_representation: A failure not good enough and easily judged

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor inquires 'how do friends actually see it / where is the evidence', or invites distinguishing facts from inferences
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The visitor tends to attribute Self-denial experiences to 'others think this way',seeing the outside world as judges
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gentle tone,validating feelings;using concrete Questioning to Clarification evidence and inferences,inviting them to list supporting and refuting facts,encouraging restating 'their thoughts' as 'my worries'.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes 'mistakes/setbacks can serve as growth opportunities' and invites experiencing present feelings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Replacing emotional experience with rational talk and logical agreement,weakening direct contact with shame and unease
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Slowing down,attending to present body sensations(such as chest tightness,breathing changes),use emotion-reflecting language,reducing Interpretation,encouraging short-sentence descriptions of 'right now I feel......'.

manifestations: Takes 'whether the degree is directly applied to the career' as the core standard of value judgment
Repeatedly doubts whether his efforts are 'worth it'
Highly sensitive to others' evaluations in social settings, worries that my studies will be seen as a waste
outcomes: Anxiety and tension,especially intensified in career topics

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: At gatherings or when talking about careers, presumes friends think one is 'wasting time' 'a failure'
Understanding Self-doubt experiences as 'they all see me this way'

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Overly worried in social situations that my words and actions will trigger negative evaluations, being cautious
Repeatedly blaming oneself 'I am not good enough',hesitating to express true feelings

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Takes 'the degree must be directly used for the career, otherwise failure' as a rigid standard

positive_force: Having strong Learning and perseverance(complete Master's degree)
Has several friends who can provide emotional support
Willing to seek help and accept psychological counseling, with motivation to change
Able to identify and name negative Automatic thoughts,with certain self-awareness and logical analysis ability
negative_force: Overly dependent on others' evaluations to determine self-worth (seeking external validation)
Catastrophizing, black-and-white thinking, and mind-reading tendencies are marked
Self-doubt and Self-deprecation leading to Social avoidance and Relationship tension
Rumination and worry interfere with sleep and work motivation; functioning impaired

target_behavior.behavior: Significant anxiety in social situations involving career/educational background,and avoiding speaking or reducing communication
antecedent: Asked about 'degree/career plans' at a friends' gathering
Hearing others discuss career paths or the topic of 'whether it is worth it'
target_behavior.core_reason: Core belief 'my value depends on others' evaluation/must directly apply the degree to a career',triggering strong Anticipation of being negated and shame
target_behavior.function: Escaping the threat of being evaluated and shame,thus reducing Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased social participation,Interpersonal tension,further damaged self-esteem

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly seeking comfort and affirmation from friends (Reassurance Seeking)
antecedent: Feeling uneasy after Reflection on career choices or being asked about degree usage
Friends not yet giving clear,consistent positive feedback
target_behavior.core_reason: Stabilizing self-worth and reducing uncertainty through others' affirmation
target_behavior.function: Gains external comfort and short-term emotional relief
target_behavior.consequence: Increased reliance on external recognition,long-term maintaining the Self-doubt cycle

target_behavior.behavior: Bedtime ruminative worry(about whether the degree is wasted,whether the future is bleak) leading to Difficulty falling asleep
antecedent: Related topics triggered in daytime social interactions
Recalls friends' comments or self-judgment before sleep
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing and overgeneralizing automatic thoughts remain active, hard to stop
target_behavior.function: Trying to find definite answers through repeated thinking to reduce uncertainty
target_behavior.consequence: Declining sleep quality,reduced daytime energy and Work motivation,Negative emotions worsening
